name: statusline
description: A live status line around the prompt: model, 7d and 5h limits, prompts and requests, main and subagent costs, the prompt cache's time left, and the project's git and pull request state; plus /statusline:handoff, which writes a handoff document before the cache goes cold.

row_git.title: Statusline: Git row
row_git.description: The project folder, branch, worktree, pull request and changes, above the prompt.

row_git_position.title: Statusline: Git row › position
row_git_position.description: Where the git row draws: above the prompt, or under it below Claude Code's hint line.

row_status.title: Statusline: Status row
row_status.description: The model, limits, context, turns, costs and cache, under the prompt.

row_status_position.title: Statusline: Status row › position
row_status_position.description: Where the status row draws: above the prompt, or under it below Claude Code's hint line.

segment_turns.title: Statusline: Status row › turns
segment_turns.description: Prompts sent and the model requests made for them.

segment_tokens.title: Statusline: Status row › costs
segment_tokens.description: What the main conversation and its subagents cost.

segment_cache.title: Statusline: Status row › cache
segment_cache.description: The prompt cache's time left and what it costs.

compact.title: Statusline: Compact spacing
compact.description: No space between the tags of the status row, nor in the git row's folders, branch and worktree.

auto_handoff.title: Statusline: Hand off before the cache goes cold
auto_handoff.description: Runs /statusline:handoff once while the session is idle, a few minutes before the prompt cache expires, and writes HANDOFF-<date-time>.md at the project's root. It runs again only after your next prompt.

fresh_start.title: Statusline: Offer a fresh start from the handoff
fresh_start.description: Once the cache is cold and this session wrote a handoff, a line under the prompt shows what the next message costs here and what a fresh session from the handoff costs, with a button that starts it.

smart_zone.title: Statusline: Smart zone on the context bar
smart_zone.description: The context bar's top half shows the smart zone left. Off, the bar shows only the context window left, in full-height blocks.

smart_zone_tokens.title: Statusline: Smart zone (tokens)
smart_zone_tokens.description: The context size up to which recall stays precise; the context bar's top half shows how much of it is left.
